product_backlog.title: Core To-Do List Application Features
product_backlog.description: Core epics covering all requirements for the to-do list web application.

product_backlog.title: Create a new to-do list
product_backlog.user_story: As a user, I want to create a new to-do list with a name so that I can organize my tasks.
product_backlog.value_hypothesis: Enables users to start organizing their tasks by category or project.
acceptance_criteria: Given the user is on the main page, When they enter a list name and click create, Then a new to-do list is created and displayed.
product_backlog.acceptance_check_note: Verified list creation feature works as expected in UI and API tests.

product_backlog.title: Ensure all team roles leave engagement comments on the sprint backlog PR prior to feature implementation.
product_backlog.overview: Ensure all team roles leave engagement comments on the sprint backlog PR prior to feature implementation.
acceptance_criteria: Given the sprint backlog PR is open, When a team role reviews the backlog, Then they leave an engagement comment on the sprint backlog PR prior to feature implementation.
product_backlog.description: Ensure all team roles leave engagement comments on the sprint backlog PR prior to feature implementation.

acceptance_criteria: Given a to-do list exists, When the user adds a task with a short text description, Then the task appears within that list.
product_backlog.value_hypothesis: Allows users to input specific actionable items into their lists.
product_backlog.title: Add a task to a list
product_backlog.user_story: As a user, I want to add a task to a list with a short text description so that I can track what needs to be done.

product_backlog.value_hypothesis: Provides immediate feedback on progress and task status.
acceptance_criteria: Given a task exists, When the user clicks to toggle its completion status, Then the task updates between complete and incomplete.
product_backlog.title: Mark a task as complete or incomplete
product_backlog.user_story: As a user, I want to mark a task as complete or incomplete so that I can track my progress.

product_backlog.value_hypothesis: Allows cleanup of obsolete or erroneous tasks.
product_backlog.user_story: As a user, I want to delete a task so that I can remove items I no longer need.
product_backlog.title: Delete a task
acceptance_criteria: Given a task exists, When the user chooses to delete the task, Then it is removed from the list.

product_backlog.title: Delete an entire list
acceptance_criteria: Given a to-do list with tasks exists, When the user chooses to delete the list, Then the list and all its contained tasks are removed.
product_backlog.user_story: As a user, I want to delete an entire list and its tasks so that I can remove whole projects or categories when no longer needed.
product_backlog.value_hypothesis: Allows clean removal of complete categories of work.

product_backlog.user_story: As a user, I want to see all my lists and tasks with completed tasks visually distinguished so that I can easily review my status.
product_backlog.value_hypothesis: Provides comprehensive visibility into user tasks and completion status.
acceptance_criteria: Given lists and tasks exist, When the user views the main application page, Then they see all lists and tasks, with completed tasks visually distinguished from incomplete ones.
product_backlog.title: View all lists and tasks with visual distinction
